item.title: Barry Bannan's first words as a Millwall player
item.description: Barry Bannan is a Millwall player. The midfielder has signed for The Lions for an undisclosed fee from Sheffield Wednesday, penning an 18-month contract at The Den. During his media duties, the Scot sat down with Millwall TV+ to discuss his arrival in South London, his hopes for the remainder of 2025/26 and beyond and more - including touching on his departure from Hillsborough. Click play on the video below to hear from Barry.

item.title: Millwall confirm Barry Bannan signing
item.description: Millwall Football Club is delighted to announce the signing of Barry Bannan from Sheffield Wednesday. The midfielder joins The Lions for an undisclosed fee and pens an 18-month contract in SE16. Bannan, 36, moves south after a decade at Hillsborough, where he became an Owls legend after making over 450 appearances across the Sky Bet Championship and League One. item.title: Lions register record 'new' Den League attendance
item.description: Last weekend's 4-0 win over Charlton Athletic saw a record League attendance at The 'new' Den registered. The crowd of 19,004 also acts as the second-highest figure the new stadium has seen since its opening in 1993; an attendance of 20,093 against Arsenal for an FA Cup tie in 1994 currently stands as the all-time record.
